request.purpose: We plan a direct-mail advertising campaign for food supplements and want to target the districts with the most patients.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised records of all adults with asthma and their inhaler prescriptions.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
ICS/LABA = ATC code starting with R03AK.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: adults with asthma, % with an active ICS/LABA, one decimal.
